issues.description: README identifies proprietary MEAD macros %crsp_day and %event as external; these are required for trading-date alignment and return windows. Cross-file macro setup and manual invocation order remain unresolved.

M2b consumes this.compustat_zips without a supplied producer; M2b writes weather_final_ny_v2 while M2a reads weather_final_ny_v2_20150604; A2c exports Analyst_Data_Final.dta while M2a consumes dataset.pull_analyst_pb_data_final; M3a retains YOUR_DIRECTORY.dta. Exact paths, producers and branch order are unresolved. M2a also defines %instown to read TFN.S34 and create dataset.erc3_data_instown, then merges that output into comp; the * %instown; statement comment does not by itself establish that the SAS macro call is disabled, so its expansion and stage order need confirmation.
The Internet Appendix lists Tables IA1–IA17 with additional robustness tests, but the package supplies no corresponding executable analysis scripts or appendix input map.

A4/M4 are identifier-only shell datasets, not the complete Analyst_Data_Final.dta or Market_Data_Final.dta used by the Stata programs. No full final analysis datasets or complete underlying inputs are packaged.

Executable SAS and Stata programs are supplied as PDFs rather than native .sas/.do scripts. Preparing runnable text requires removing printed line numbers and resolving PDF wrapping/page continuations against the original; the extracted text is not yet a verified executable source file.

review_notes: Manual source tracing was required because the frozen dependency list is empty and static file-extension counts do not detect SAS/Stata code embedded in the supplied PDF files.
A4 and M4 are readable, identifier-only shell datasets; their one-row metadata probes do not establish coverage and do not support an analysis-only scope.
Local catalog probes are bounded one-row metadata candidates only. Missing exact catalog names and probe failures are retained as unverified, not as proof of absence or lack of license.
No author code, regression, or dataset download was executed. Final execution and output validation remain unverified.
